Dear Ms Hughes,

I am writing to apply for the role of volunteer assistant at the Welcome Centre, which I saw advertised on your website.

Having moved to Leeds from Brazil myself, I know how confusing the first few weeks in a new country can be, from registering an address to finding a doctor. I would love to help other newcomers through that process.

Last year I helped several friends fill in official forms and translated at meetings with landlords and schools. I speak Portuguese and German, and my English is improving fast. I would describe myself as patient, reliable and well organised, and I enjoy working with people.

I am available on weekday evenings and at weekends, and I could commit to around six hours a week. I would also be happy to attend any training you provide.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss it with you.

Yours sincerely,
Oliver
